visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a black cap and dark mesh top sits outdoors at night, holding chopsticks over a white bowl. A pink graphic overlay with the text "Couple QA" and a question about holidays appears above her. Behind her, strings of warm yellow fairy lights hang against a dark background, and a dark tent is partially visible. She is smiling and gesturing with her hands while speaking. (2) The camera cuts to a young man in a black t-shirt sitting across from her. He picks up food from a small white container with chopsticks. A portable power station and a small LED lantern are on the table beside him, illuminating his face with bright, cool light. He looks towards the woman and speaks calmly. (3) The shots alternate between the man and the woman as they eat and talk. The woman is seen eating noodles, her facial expressions animated as she listens and responds. The setting remains dark and cozy, focused on the brightly lit table area. (4) A close-up shot shows the man lifting a piece of meat from a pan on the table. The woman in the background laughs, and animated pink bubbles float across the screen briefly as she describes a romantic concept. (5) The video concludes with a shot of the woman smiling brightly while holding food with her chopsticks, continuing the casual conversation in the warm, campsite-like environment.
